sources.description: One prospect the Denver Broncos have shown interest in and could select in the second round of the 2026 NFL Draft is Memphis tackle Travis Burke. He is a 6-9, 325-pound offensive tackle known for his size, strength, and physical demeanor. The Athletic’s lead draft analyst, Dane Brugler, has Burke ranked as his 9th-best offensive […]
